Nine tasks coded in-session with ZERO subagents; ONE subagent, the close reviewer, at 181,605 tokens / 37 tool calls / 10.5 min. The phase's 14 mutants all DIED, i.e. they confirmed assertions that were already right; the reviewer REFUTED. Nine tasks coded in-session with ZERO coding subagents; TWO reviewers, both FRESH, NEITHER RESUMED — 244,568 tokens / 67 calls / 838s (close) and 213,923 / 72 / 1,058s (remediation). Main-session cost UNMEASURED (runbook O3) — NOT comparable to 09's 6.37M. STOP-LOSS 675,000, NOT BREACHED: 458,491, with 32% of headroom unused — the first phase since 16a to come in under, and the direct result of §2.115's fresh-not-resumed rule (13 spent 604,655 on ONE agent resumed twice, whose per-call cost rose 24x as its workload fell 2 orders of magnitude). THE ROI LINE: pass 1 returned 1 CRITICAL + 9 MAJOR + 8 MINOR against a tree that was NINE-for-nine green on pnpm verify AND on CI by full SHA, with every CRITICAL task's mutants built and killed and sixteen findings already self-reported. The CRITICAL is a silent stock loss: postMovements wrote an application-computed ABSOLUTE balance through an upsert and SELECT … FOR UPDATE cannot lock a row that does not exist, so two concurrent receipts into a NEW (store,batch) pair both read 0 and both wrote q — ledger 2q, balance q, and the loss lands HIGH so the non-negative CHECK never fires. Mutant DIED at {ledgerSum:10, balance:5}. Pass 2, over the REMEDIATION, returned a MAJOR the remediation's own commit message had claimed as fixed: M6 moved the GRN menu permission in the manifest and not in the SPA's hard-coded NAV table, so DD11's QC signatory still had no link — third consecutive phase (09a, 13, 14) whose worst late defect is inside the fix for an earlier finding. The executing session ALSO found two defects in the handed-off remediation before either reviewer saw it, by RUNNING it: the C1 fix failed 13 tests because a CHECK is evaluated against the proposed tuple before ON CONFLICT resolves, and the M2 fix made a recovery reachable that would have raised 25P02 on an aborted transaction. Ledger 2.119-2.124; EXECUTE-METHOD-V3 gains §9.6 (a handoff spends its last budget on RUNNING, not on writing). ARCHIVE pass retired §2.28 and explicitly KEPT §2.38.
